verdict.rationale: The API overview docs state that turbopuffer has a public OpenAPI specification and link the official turbopuffer-openapi GitHub repo, which publishes openapi.yml and is the source the official SDKs are generated from. The README warns the spec is primarily for internal use, may contain nonstandard features, and may change without notice, and probes found no spec at conventional website paths (it lives on GitHub). Missing for 10: a stability or versioning guarantee for the spec, discovery at a standard well-known URL, independent hands-on corroboration of using the spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
